socketUnlock.method: eligible through branch progression, then opened with a dedicated unlock item

stoneTypes.basic: Generic elemental/stat modifiers that affect whichever evolution is currently active.
stoneTypes.special: Mechanic-changing modifiers derived from former standalone skills/effects. Their behavior adapts to the currently active evolution.

uiDirection.layout: evolution path above/center, current-skill details/preview, five sockets along bottom

specialStoneCandidates.Burning: Applies a fire damage-over-time effect; adapts to the active fire evolution.
specialStoneCandidates.FireWall: Leaves persistent fire zones/trails depending on the active fire evolution.
specialStoneCandidates.ScortchedEarth: Creates scorched ground after impacts; scale/count adapts to the active fire evolution.
specialStoneCandidates.FireStorm: Adds a secondary area-fire burst or storm behavior to impacts.
specialStoneCandidates.FlameArt: Reserved legendary/special modifier; Zircon entry is not coded, so ORIGINS may define it freely.

fire.designNote: The five evolution stages are one evolving skill, not five simultaneously usable skills. Stones belong to the fire branch and remain equipped when the skill evolves.

candidates.IceBlades: Single-target ice attack/projectile; applies stronger high-level slow profile.
candidates.FrozenEarth: Long forward ice line up to 8 cells with weaker side hits; applies slow.
candidates.GreaterFrozenEarth: Expanded FrozenEarth covering three forward lanes plus weaker side hits.
candidates.IceStorm: Targeted small-area ice burst around a selected location; applies slow.
candidates.IceRain: Large targeted zone with multiple random delayed ice impacts; source contains an unfinished freeze-poison hook.
candidates.FrostBite: Temporary self buff; when it ends it bursts around the caster and damages nearby non-boss monsters.
candidates.IceAura: Creates a persistent ice effect on a struck cell that repeatedly applies paralysis to valid targets.
candidates.IceBreaker: Expanding radial ice burst centered on the caster, radius 2.
candidates.FrozenDragon: Two successive expanding radial ice pulses centered on the caster, radius 2.

ice.notes: Order is intentionally not decided yet. Likely some entries become special stones/effects rather than evolution stages.
